[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/crates-acme-test/"

[registry]
global-credential-providers = ["cargo:token"]

[source.acme-src]
registry = "sparse+https://crates.acme.test/index/"
replace-with = "spindrift-registry-proxy-crates-acme-test-acme"

[source.spindrift-registry-proxy-crates-acme-test-acme]
registry = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/crates-acme-test/index/"

[registries.spindrift-registry-proxy-crates-acme-test-acme]
index = "sparse+http://127.0.0.1:27182/crates-acme-test/index/"
